department.en: Transport Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: A temporary licence, valid for 6 months, to learn to drive.
summary.hi: सीखने के लिए 6 महीने की अस्थायी लाइसेंस।
summary.hn: Driving seekhne ke liye 6 mahine ka temporary licence.

text.en: A learner's licence, valid up to 6 months and valid throughout India. It lets you learn with an experienced licensed driver. No driving test is needed at this stage.

You must have completed 18 years of age to drive a motor vehicle other than a transport vehicle. At 16 you can get a licence for a motorcycle without gear of up to 50 cc, with a parent or guardian's consent.
For a transport vehicle licence: age 20, an effective light motor vehicle licence held for at least one year, and 8th standard pass.
Form 1 (declaration of physical fitness) and Form 2 (application for a learner's licence).
Self-attested copies of proof of residence and proof of age.
A medical certificate in Form 1A is required for transport vehicle licences and, as the pages state, for applicants above 40 years in other categories (one page says above 50).
For a transport vehicle: self-attested proof of 8th standard pass and a copy of the light motor vehicle licence held.
₹500 for one category of vehicle, ₹950 for two, ₹1,400 for three. A retest costs ₹50.
Not stated on the official pages: verify locally. The licence is valid for 6 months.
Apply to the licensing authority where you live, with the forms, photos, proofs and fee. The Transport Department has an online appointment and payment service.
Apply for the permanent licence after 30 days and within 6 months of the learner's licence being issued.

notes: The two official pages differ on the medical certificate age (above 40 or above 50), so check with the licensing office.
